entries.cite: Scholl, Williams, Bornet, ..., Browaeys, ..., Weidemueller, 'Microwave-engineering of programmable XXZ Hamiltonians in arrays of Rydberg atoms', PRX Quantum 3, 020303 (2022)
entries.verified: full text (PDF): H_XX = 1/2 sum J_ij (sx sx + sy sy), J_ij = C3(1-3cos^2 th)/(2 r^3); 4-pulse (X,-Y,Y,-X) sequence gives Hav with anisotropy delta = Jz/Jx tunable in 0 < delta < 2 (conclusion: 0 <= delta <= 2); requirement J_m t_c << 2 pi, J_m t_c ~ 2 pi x 0.2 judged sufficient; 32-atom 2D array a = 27 um, J = 2pi x 133 kHz, J_m = 2pi x 720 kHz, t_c = 300 ns, Gaussian pulses 16.8 ns (1/e^2), 3 us of driving; 1D chain 10 atoms a = 19 um, J = 2pi x 270 kHz; optical pumping 99.5%, STIRAP ~95%, addressed preparation ~95% per atom, detection false positives 5% / false negatives 3.5%; pulse error Delta theta = 0.06 +- 0.01 rad per pulse (single-atom calibration); limitations: microwave pulse imperfections and finite pulse duration (4x Rabi would fix the latter).

entries.cite: Geier, Thaicharoen, Hainaut, Franz, Salzinger, Tebben, Grimshandl, Zuern, Weidemueller, 'Floquet Hamiltonian Engineering of an Isolated Many-Body Spin System' (Science 374, 1149 (2021) - journal ref UNVERIFIED)
entries.verified: abstract: Rydberg states in an ultracold gas; Floquet sequences change the symmetry of the effective Heisenberg XYZ Hamiltonian; relaxation of total spin modified; dynamics 'qualitatively captured by a semi-classical simulation'.

entries.cite: Geier, Braemer, Braun, Muellenbach, Franz, Gaerttner, Zuern, Weidemueller, 'Time-reversal in a dipolar quantum many-body spin system', Phys. Rev. Research 6, 033197 (2024)
entries.verified: abstract + HTML full text (via WebFetch summary): sign flip by changing encoding states: |61S1/2,1/2>,|61P1/2,1/2> (Delta m = 0, C3/2pi = 3.2 GHz um^3) vs |61P1/2,-1/2>,|62S1/2,1/2> (Delta m = +-1, C3/2pi = -2.8 GHz um^3); ratio k = 1.1 theory, 1.03 measured; disordered gas of 332-1333 atoms, J_m/2pi = 0.43-0.95 MHz; initial magnetisation ~0.5, revival to M ~ 0.2 after t_rev = 6 us; atomic motion ~50 nm per us, ||dJ|| ~ 20% after 6 interaction cycles; transfer infidelity dominates at short times; Floquet-engineered XXZ reversed for Jz/Jperp = 0.14-1; transfer Rabi 2pi x 9 and 11 MHz.

entries.cite: Bornet, Emperauger, Chen, Ye, Block, ..., Browaeys, 'Scalable spin squeezing in a dipolar Rydberg atom array', Nature 621, 728 (2023)
entries.verified: abstract: up to 100 atoms, 2D dipolar XY, squeezing -3.5 dB raw (~-5 dB after detection-error correction), Floquet-engineered Heisenberg freezing.

entries.cite: Chen, Bornet, Bintz, Emperauger, Leclerc, ..., 'Continuous symmetry breaking in a two-dimensional Rydberg array', Nature 616, 691 (2023)
entries.verified: abstract only (2D dipolar XY, adiabatic preparation); size and error numbers not in abstract.

entries.cite: Barredo, Lienhard, de Leseleuc, Lahaye, Browaeys, 'Synthetic three-dimensional atomic structures assembled atom by atom', Nature 561, 79 (2018)
entries.verified: abstract: arbitrarily shaped 3D arrays, up to 72 atoms, separations of a few micrometres, holographic plane-by-plane assembly.

entries.cite: Barredo, Lienhard, Scholl, et al., 'Three-dimensional trapping of individual Rydberg atoms in ponderomotive bottle beam traps'
entries.verified: API listing: experimental 3D trapping of individual Rydberg atoms; two atoms 40 um apart.

entries.cite: Manetsch, Nomura, Bataille, Leung, Lv, ..., 'A tweezer array with 6100 highly coherent atomic qubits', Nature 647, 60 (2025)
entries.verified: abstract: >6100 atoms in ~12000 sites (2D), hyperfine coherence 12.6 s, imaging fidelity > 99.99%. Not a Rydberg-interaction or 3D result.

entries.cite: de Leseleuc, Barredo, Lienhard, Browaeys, Lahaye, 'Analysis of imperfections in the coherent optical excitation of single atoms to Rydberg states', PRA 97, 053803 (2018)
entries.verified: abstract: SPAM errors modelled and measured; Rydberg lifetime n^3 scaling observed; damping from several effects each at the few-percent level.

entries.cite: Beterov, Ryabtsev, Tretyakov, Entin, 'Quasiclassical calculations of BBR-induced depopulation rates and effective lifetimes of Rydberg nS, nP and nD alkali-metal atoms with n < 80', PRA 79, 052504 (2009)
entries.verified: full text (PDF): Eq. (16) and Tables I-II (Rb coefficients). Evaluated here with Rb quantum defects 3.131 (S), 2.654 (P1/2), 2.641 (P3/2) [quantum defects recalled, INFERENCE]: tau_eff(61S, 300 K) = 105 us, (61P1/2) = 134 us; at 4 K 262-474 us; 80S 300 K = 201 us.

entries.cite: Gaerttner, Bohnet, Safavi-Naini, Wall, Bollinger, Rey, 'Measuring out-of-time-order correlations and multiple quantum spectra in a trapped ion quantum magnet', Nat. Phys. 13, 781 (2017)
entries.verified: abstract: >100 ions in a Penning trap, long-range Ising, OTOCs by time reversal, MQC spectra, up to 8-body correlations.

entries.cite: Sanchez, Chattah, Wei, Buljubasich, Cappellaro, Pastawski, 'Perturbation independent decay of the Loschmidt echo in a many-body system', PRL 124, 030601 (2020)
entries.verified: abstract: solid-state NMR quantum simulator, hundreds of spins, OTOCs and LEs with scaled dipolar dynamics; when interactions dominate the perturbation, LE decay rate T3 ~ T2, independent of the perturbation.

entries.cite: Choi, Zhou, Knowles, Landig, Choi, Lukin, 'Robust dynamic Hamiltonian engineering of many-body spin systems', PRX 10, 031002 (2020)
entries.verified: abstract: periodic pulse sequences designed with a matrix (Pauli-frame) formalism for robust Hamiltonian engineering against disorder and pulse imperfections (NV-ensemble experiment).

entries.cite: Gao, Martin, Hughes, Leitao, Put, ..., 'Signal amplification in a solid-state quantum sensor via asymmetric time-reversal of many-body dynamics' (2025)
entries.verified: abstract: 2D NV ensemble, Floquet-engineered time-reversed two-axis twisting; optimal amplification at backward time = 2x forward.

entries.cite: Carroll, Hirzler, Miller, Wellnitz, Muleady, ..., 'Observation of generalized t-J spin dynamics with tunable dipolar interactions', Science (DOI 10.1126/science.adq0911)
entries.verified: abstract: KRb molecules, spin in two lowest rotational states, Ising and spin-exchange couplings tuned independently. Whether Jz/Jperp can be made negative (needed for the traceless form) is NOT stated in the abstract.

entries.cite: Xiang, Zhang, Liu, Zhou, Yuan, ..., 'Observation of quantum information collapse-and-revival in a strongly-interacting Rydberg atom array'
entries.verified: abstract: first OTOC and Holevo-information measurements in a Rydberg array (blockade/PXP-type, scars), digital-analogue time reversal. Sizes and accuracies not in abstract.

entries.cite: Liang, Yue, Chao, Hua, Lin, ..., 'Observation of anomalous information scrambling in a Rydberg atom array', PRL 135, 050201 (2025)
entries.verified: abstract: vdW-dominated tweezer array, OTOC with persistent oscillations inside a suppressed light cone (scars). Numbers not in abstract.

entries.cite: Toga, Darbha, Rrapaj, Lopes, Kemper, 'Information Propagation in Rydberg Arrays via Analog OTOC Calculations' (2026)
entries.verified: abstract: QuEra Aquila, randomized global quenches (no full time reversal), 1D chains, compared with state-vector and MPS simulation.

entries.cite: Google Quantum AI (Abanin et al.), 'Constructive interference at the edge of quantum ergodic dynamics', Nature 646, 825 (2025)
